A '''weapons shop''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xerxes]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During this period, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] intended to use the establishment, but was afraid that local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] were lying in wait for him inside. After staking the place out for an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] with no success, he attempted to bribe a citizen to enter the store to investigate for the sum of twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG" />
